hooks.name: review-reminder
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, reminds the agent to run its tests and the reviewer (foundation Requirement 22.13).

action.prompt: Run the reviewer sub-agent on this task's diff and record the verdict in STATUS.md. Before that, run the task-tests skill (bash scripts/hooks/task-tests.sh <spec> <task-id>) so the task's tests leave Evidence records.
